comment: No source is published. What is above comes from the maker's manual, the panel artwork and the module's own port and parameter names. The panel and the CV jacks are laid out exactly as Rain's, and the width control follows the same law, so the two are interchangeable in a patch. The manual's defaults - density 30 per cent, clarity 100 per cent and freq 10 per cent - are fixed in the module.
